snippet.title: One More Run "Break the Game" Trailer
snippet.description:
The first trailer is here for my upcoming roguelite game One More Run - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541210/One_More_Run/

Video edited by:  [https://www.youtube.com/@Ram21s]

Want to follow development? Join the Discord at https://discord.gg/vmWQFWBu

One More Run is an easy to learn, difficult to master roguelite that blends several game genres into one cohesive world. You'll choose from 5 fantasy themed mechs (classes) that each play vastly differently from one another while gradually building a customized mech with modules found during each run to overcome growing challenges.

This is a very early teaser trailer to show the core game loop and begin gathering feedback. I have a developer commentary style video planned for the near future that will get much more in-depth. I'm so excited to show everyone more of what I've been working on ^^
